topic: Educational: how to ask for a review

slides.label: Reviews
slides.headline:
How to ask
for a review.

slides.title: Ask right after the job.
slides.lead: The work is fresh, so it is easiest to say yes.

slides.title: Send the direct link.
slides.lead: One tap to the review page. No searching, no extra steps.

slides.title: Say what to mention.
slides.lead: Ask them to describe what you did and how it went.

slides.title: Reply to every review.
slides.lead: A short thank you shows the next customer you are listening.

caption:
How to ask for a review.

Ask right after the job, send the direct link, say what to mention, and reply to every review.

Message us to begin.
